Report mandates (5 report mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to publish or file a report, with a City Record filing receipt when that report appears.

  • ◆Mandate · Submit to the speaker of the council and post to its website an annual report regarding the programs, services, costs, and rates of utilization for all senior centers under the department’s jurisdiction.
    report · deadline 2018-09-01 · annual · §21-207(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit an annual report on the department’s outreach efforts to the mayor and the speaker of the council, and post the report on the department’s website, including specified outreach metrics and recommendations.
    report · deadline: Beginning no later than one year after the commissioner publishes the pamphlet as required by subdivision b of this section · annual · § 21-210(d) · Source law↗

    report · one-time · Int. No. 1022, § 1(d) · Source law↗

    report · deadline: No later than 1 year after the effective date of this local law · one-time · Int. No. 1053, §1(c) · Source law↗
